story.summaryEn:
Charles 🗣️ "It was quite tricky on track today, as the surface was slippery, so we will work on that to find some improvements for tomorrow."
Wrapping up a mixed practice day 🇲🇽
detailZh:
查尔斯说：“今天的赛道上非常棘手，因为路面很滑，所以我们将努力改进，为明天找到一些提升。”
总结一个混合练习日 🇲🇽
detailEn:
Charles 🗣️ "It was quite tricky on track today, as the surface was slippery, so we will work on that to find some improvements for tomorrow."
Wrapping up a mixed practice day 🇲🇽
